answer: In an agent market trading tundra surveys and nectar forecasts, each agent must lock collateral for 30 days to anchor its voting weight. Votes are weighted by the amount locked, so splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities gives no more influence than keeping them in one account. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital that cannot be spent or lent during the lock.
